_comment: This file lists what UN_FeedR watches for. Real JSON has no comment syntax,
so this '_comment' field is just documentation -- the script ignores it.
keywords: plain words or phrases. Matching is case-insensitive and whole-word,
so 'AI' won't accidentally match inside a word like 'faIled'.
resolutions: UN resolution symbols, e.g. 'A/RES/79/325'. The script automatically
also matches common variants people actually use, like 'resolution 79/325' or
'79325 (2025)', without you needing to list every variant yourself.
Add or remove entries whenever you like. Each entry gets its own RSS feed at
feeds/<slug-of-term>.xml, and everything also appears together in feeds/all.xml.
